about: WCRP Risk and Vulnerability Indicators by barrio: each area's index (percentile among barrios, 0 to 100) in the original as published and in the observatory's updated version (same method, current data). The arrays follow geo.ids; a null is a barrio with no value (no residents). Ranks are the fifths of the index. Built by wcrp_rvi.py; method, inputs and known errors on wcrp.html and in the data dictionary.

wcrp_rvi.name: Hunter College for Foundation for Puerto Rico (WCRP) — Risk and Vulnerability Indicators, ArcGIS services (2022)
wcrp_rvi.license: No open license stated (licenseInfo and accessInformation are empty); FPR publishes it with the program's approval; ask PRDOH and FPR before re-use

acs.name: US Census Bureau — American Community Survey 5-year estimates
acs.license: US Government work; cite the Census Bureau as the source

conditions.name: PR Data Observatory, local conditions by barrio (conditions_barrio.json): EPA TRI, Facility Registry Service, ATTAINS, Green Book and LMOP; HUD CHAS 2016-2020; Census TIGER/Line 2026; drive time to a CMS general hospital along OpenStreetMap roads
conditions.license: Public domain (EPA, HUD, Census Bureau, CMS); the drive time uses OpenStreetMap roads (ODbL)

orig.label: Per capita income ($; shown in the table, not an input of the index per the white paper)
People aged 3 to 24 not enrolled in school (%)
Adults 25+ without a high school diploma (%)
In a sulfur dioxide or lead non-attainment area (1 = yes)
Municipal landfill or open dump (1 = yes)
Travel time to the nearest general hospital (minutes)
Severe housing problems, HUD CHAS definition (%)

rebuild.label: Households with cash public assistance income (%)
People aged 3 to 24 not enrolled in school (%)
rebuild.from: B14003: not enrolled aged 3 to 24 / everyone aged 3 to 24

rebuild.label: Adults 25+ without a high school diploma (%)
In a sulfur dioxide or lead non-attainment area (1 = yes)
rebuild.note: Areas still in non-attainment in the EPA Green Book: San Juan and Guayama-Salinas for sulfur dioxide, Arecibo for lead.

rebuild.label: In a 303(d)-listed water assessment unit, EPA ATTAINS (1 = yes)
rebuild.note: Puerto Rico maps the assessment units of its rivers as the land that drains to each assessed reach, so a listed unit covers a watershed and far more barrios touch one than in the original, which does not say how it drew the waters. The input separates barrios less than the original's.

rebuild.label: Risk Management Plan facilities, active (count)
rebuild.note: Only the facilities the Facility Registry Service marks active are counted, far fewer than the original counted; it does not say which it took.

rebuild.label: Municipal solid waste landfill, open or closed, EPA LMOP (1 = yes)
rebuild.note: EPA's Landfill Methane Outreach Program lists municipal solid waste landfills only (open or closed), not open dumps; the original's landfill or open dump layer was supplied by FPR.

rebuild.label: Drive time to the nearest general hospital (minutes, estimate)
rebuild.note: The observatory's estimate along OpenStreetMap roads at free-flow speeds, from each barrio's population-weighted point to the nearest general hospital with an emergency department (CMS list); 0 where the barrio holds one. Vieques, Culebra and Isla de Mona have no road to a hospital and no value: their health level uses the other two inputs.

rebuild.label: Households with severe housing problems, CHAS 2016–2020 (%, estimate)
rebuild.note: CHAS is published for census tracts, not barrios: the barrio value is an estimate, the tract counts spread by 2020 housing units. 2016–2020 is the newest window a script may read.

rebuild.label: Street intersections per square mile, TIGER/Line 2026 (fewer is more vulnerable)
rebuild.note: Intersections where three or more street edges meet (TIGER/Line 2026; no highways, ramps or paths) over land area. The original counted TIGER 2020 roads in a way it does not describe, so only the order of the barrios compares, not the values.

missing.label: Solid waste facilities (transfer stations, recycling, open dumps)
missing.why: No public source states terms: EPA lists municipal landfills only, and the only list of open dumps found (DRNA, 2014) states no license.

context.label: Residents aged 65 and over (%, survey estimate)

method.context_note: Not an input of the index. The white paper's method has no age input; the original dashboard showed each barrio's age groups (under 17, over 65 and age bands, ACS 2015-2019) beside the index as its vulnerable population. The updated version shows the same groups from the current survey; they change no level.

hazards.label: Residents on land highly susceptible to landslides (estimate, %)

method.hazards_note: Not an input of the index: the white paper keeps natural hazards such as flooding, landslides and earthquakes in separate layers. The landslide susceptibility map (USGS, Hughes and Schulz 2020) covers the main island only.

vars.label: WCRP vulnerability, overall: original 2022 (ACS 2015–2019)
vars.ref: WCRP Risk and Vulnerability Indicators (Hunter College, 2022), as published
vars.definition: The overall index of the Risk and Vulnerability Indicators that Hunter College built for FPR's WCRP program, as published in March 2022 (inputs mostly ACS 2015–2019): the barrio's percentile among the 887 barrios with residents, times 100 (higher is more vulnerable). Ranks are its fifths: 1 (0–20) low to 5 (above 80) high. Not recomputed.
vars.noValue: Ranked among barrios only: shown by barrio

vars.label: WCRP vulnerability, overall: updated 2020–2024
vars.ref: Updated by the observatory with the RVI method (wcrp_rvi.py)
vars.definition: The overall index updated by the observatory with the RVI white paper's method on ACS 2020–2024 and the observatory's current EPA, HUD CHAS, TIGER and hospital drive-time data: percentiles of each input among barrios, summed within the area and ranked again (the overall index sums the six areas). Times 100; ranks are fifths. One input of the original, solid waste facilities other than landfills, has no current source and is left out (see the dictionary).
vars.noValue: Ranked among barrios only: shown by barrio
